---
title: "Transcriptomics runtime check"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
project_library <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("R_LIBS_USER"), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
runtime_library <- normalizePath(.Library, winslash = "/")
allowed <- c(project_library, runtime_library)
stopifnot(all(normalizePath(.libPaths(), winslash = "/") %in% allowed))
for (package in c("shiny", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "edgeR")) {
  stopifnot(requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE))
  actual_library <- dirname(normalizePath(find.package(package), winslash = "/"))
  stopifnot(identical(actual_library, project_library))
}
value <- shiny::reactiveVal(20L)
value(21L)
cat(sprintf("Runtime check passed with value %d.", 2L * shiny::isolate(value())))
```
